source_storage: Original workbooks are external inputs and are not redistributed in this repository.

matching_policy.normalizer: The same supplied species-name normalizer is used for both trait definitions and all habitats.
matching_policy.strict_species: Exclude aggregates, sections, hybrids, uncertain concepts and explicit infraspecific labels before normalization. EIVE additionally requires TaxonRank=Species.
matching_policy.synonyms: No new synonym inference, fuzzy matching, genus/family imputation or infraspecific averaging.
matching_policy.duplicates: Identical numeric values or statuses retain one species key. Conflicting values or statuses produce status=conflict and no numeric value.
matching_policy.habitats: Each species has one fixed value within each indicator definition, shared across all habitats.
matching_policy.excluded_names: Excluded or nonmatching trait names are absent from the returned status map and are classified as unmatched by the analysis.

status_policy.numeric: A finite source value inside that definition's closed numeric limits.
status_policy.indifferent: Tichy literal x. Retain as a separate ecological status, never zero, a midpoint or true missingness.
status_policy.missing: A source NA or empty value, distinguished from indifferent and from unmatched names.
status_policy.conflict: Multiple different numeric values or statuses normalize to the same species key. No value is selected.
status_policy.zero: Zero is valid on the EIVE 0-10 scale and invalid on the Tichy 1-12 scale.

tichy.citation: Tichy L., Axmanova I., Dengler J., et al. (2023). Ellenberg-type indicator values for European vascular plant species. Journal of Vegetation Science 34, e13168.
tichy.units: Ellenberg-compatible temperature niche indicator; not degrees Celsius or physiological heat tolerance
tichy.nomenclature: Euro+Med PlantBase, with source-defined species and aggregates
tichy.construction: Means across compatible regional systems, with additional values estimated from EVA co-occurrences. Broad generalists can retain x instead of a definitive value.
tichy.publication_count_note: The article abstract reports 7400 temperature values; the checksum-verified fixed v2 workbook contains 7402 numeric temperature entries. The adapter validates the pinned-file census.

eive.citation: Dengler J., Jansen F., Chusova O., et al. (2023). Ecological Indicator Values for Europe (EIVE) 1.0. Vegetation Classification and Survey 4, 7-29.
eive.units: Continuous European temperature niche position; not degrees Celsius or physiological heat tolerance
eive.construction: Consensus of regional indicator systems rescaled to 0-10. The published construction assigns a source-system mean niche position to indifferent source taxa and retains broad niche-width information. EIVE 1.0 did not use EVA to derive the consensus values.
eive.rank_exception: The source row named Lupinus angustifolius subsp angustifolius is labeled Species. It is excluded by its explicit infraspecific name; the genuine species row is retained.
eive.comparison_note: EIVE is a separate definition and scale, not a numeric filling of Tichy x values. Both systems share regional indicator sources and are not independent ecological replications.

kashmir_paired_source.selection: The same 16 station transects in baseline 2014, requiring all four original quadrats. Between-station transects and 2017 observations are excluded.
kashmir_paired_source.mask_policy: Apply the union of unresolved source-name base keys across the selected rail and interior observations to both sides of every station pair.
kashmir_paired_source.output_policy: Return only in-memory species-set pairs. Export no original station identifiers, species-by-site matrix or coordinates.
